local function getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId)
    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]
    if not statements then
        return {}
    end

    local originalStatements = mw.clone(statements)
    local cloneOfStatements = {}

    for _, statement in ipairs(originalStatements) do
        local cloneOfStatement = mw.clone(statement)
        cloneOfStatement.qualifiers = nil
        cloneOfStatement.references = nil
        table.insert(cloneOfStatements, cloneOfStatement)
    end

    for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
        cloneOfStatement.qualifiers = originalStatements[cloneKey].qualifiers
        cloneOfStatement.references = originalStatements[cloneKey].references
    end

    return cloneOfStatements
end

function mw.wikibase.entity.getStatements(entity, propertyId)
    local statements = getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId)
    return statements
end

import re

def parse_filename(filename):
    # Define the regular expression pattern
    pattern = r'^(?P<namespace>\w+):(?P<params>.+)$'
    
    # Match the filename against the pattern
    match = re.match(pattern, filename)
    
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Invalid filename format")
    
    # Extract the namespace and parameters from the match
    namespace = match.group('namespace')
    params = match.group('params')
    
    # Check if the filename is empty
    if not filename:
        raise ValueError("Filename must not be empty")
    
    return namespace, params
